_note: Draft in-sentence modifiers for each fixed claim wording (Claude, 2026-10-02). [[...]] marks the modifier span, so a run can mask it apart from the rest of the phrase. A denial must leave no reading where he is partly or recently vegan: 'not a committed vegan' or 'not a longtime vegan' would, so those take 'never'. Generic and specific pre/post negations wait for Gabriel's definition. Caveat for masking: only a pure insertion keeps the claim intact once the modifier is masked ('He is [[not]] vegan' masks to 'He is vegan'); denials that drop a time phrase ('He has [[never]] been vegan' from 'He has been vegan since 2016') mask to a different claim, so a modifier-masking run should use the insertion wordings only.

Daniel has been a vegan for years..uncertain: Daniel [[may have]] been a vegan for years.

Daniel went vegan in his twenties..uncertain: Daniel [[may have]] gone vegan in his twenties.
